exposure: Omnipod 5 (OP5) automated insulin delivery (AID) system use
cohort: Matched pairs (n = 132) of White and Black youth with type 1 diabetes (T1D) using the Omnipod 5 (OP5) AID system at two pediatric academic centers.
finding: Gaps in time in range (TIR) and average continuous glucose monitor (CGM) glucose between White and Black youth narrow with automated insulin delivery (AID) use, but do not close completely, indicating the need for additional interventions to address social determinants of health.
